_doc: PRIOR ART: scripts/maintenance/set-pipeline-priority.mjs — boosts named BOOK ids by hand, once; it cannot name an author or a subject, and a boost it set never updates as new books arrive. Named shelves for queue priority v2 (#7502, scripts/maintenance/priority-v2.mjs). A book on a shelf gets a fixed bonus to its value, on top of demand and importance. Every shelf names who asked for it and when; a shelf without that line does not belong here. Match is on books.author_id, an author-name pattern (for books with no author_id), categories, or collections.

shelves.asked: Derek, 2026-10 (memory: harmony books are pre-approved for OCR and translation)
